```{python}
#| label: fig-mosfet-ssm-simple
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Simplified small-signal models of the MOSFET in saturation for hand calculations: $\\pi$-model (left), preferred when the input is at the gate, and $\\tau$-model (right), preferred when the input is at the source. In the $\\tau$-model, the current through the resistor $1/g_\\mathrm{m}$ equals $i_\\mathrm{ds}$, which is mirrored by the controlled source into the drain."

import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=11)

    # --- pi model ---
    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((0, 3)).label('G', 'left')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((0, 3), (2, 3))
    d += elm.Capacitor().endpoints((2, 3), (2, 0)).label(
        '$C_\\mathrm{GS}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Gap().endpoints((1.2, 3), (1.2, 0)).label(
        ['+', '$v_\\mathrm{gs}$', '$-$'])
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((2, 0), (6.3, 0))
    d += elm.SourceI().endpoints((4, 3), (4, 0)).label(
        '$g_\\mathrm{m} v_\\mathrm{gs}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((4, 3), (7.3, 3))
    d += elm.Dot().at((4, 0))
    d += elm.Resistor().endpoints((6.3, 3), (6.3, 0)).label(
        '$g_\\mathrm{ds}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Dot().at((6.3, 3))
    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((7.3, 3)).label('D', 'right')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((4, 0), (4, -1))
    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((4, -1)).label('S', 'bottom')

    # --- T model ---
    x0 = 10
    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((x0, 3)).label('G', 'left')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0, 3), (x0 + 2, 3))
    d += elm.Capacitor().endpoints((x0 + 2, 3), (x0 + 2, 0)).label(
        '$C_\\mathrm{GS}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Dot().at((x0 + 2, 3))
    r_gm = elm.Resistor().endpoints((x0 + 3.5, 3), (x0 + 3.5, 0)).label(
        '$1/g_\\mathrm{m}$', loc='bottom')
    d += r_gm
    d += elm.CurrentLabelInline(direction='in').at(r_gm).label(
        '$i_\\mathrm{ds}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Dot().at((x0 + 3.5, 3))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0 + 2, 0), (x0 + 3.5, 0))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0 + 2, 3), (x0 + 3.5, 3))
    d += elm.SourceI().endpoints((x0 + 3.5, 5.5),
                                           (x0 + 3.5, 3)).label(
        '$i_\\mathrm{ds}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Resistor().endpoints((x0 + 5.5, 5.5), (x0 + 5.5, 3)).label(
        '$g_\\mathrm{ds}$', loc='bottom')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0 + 3.5, 5.5), (x0 + 5.5, 5.5))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0 + 5.5, 3), (x0 + 5.5, 0))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0 + 5.5, 0), (x0 + 3.5, 0))
    d += elm.Dot().at((x0 + 3.5, 5.5))
    d += elm.Dot().at((x0 + 3.5, 3))
    d += elm.Dot().at((x0 + 3.5, 0))
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0 + 3.5, 5.5), (x0 + 3.5, 6.5))
    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((x0 + 3.5, 6.5)).label('D', 'top')
    d += elm.Line().endpoints((x0 + 3.5, 0), (x0 + 3.5, -1))
    d += elm.Dot(open=True).at((x0 + 3.5, -1)).label('S', 'bottom')
```
